data.name: Inbox
data.comment: The first child of a mailbox group: the page of the whole mailbox, standing for its main address.

data.name: DayFormat
data.comment: A .NET date pattern: weekday and day, « Fri 13 ». Used when the day is in the current month.

data.name: DayWithMonthFormat
data.comment: A .NET date pattern: weekday, day and month, « Tue 1 Dec ». Used when the day is not in the current month.

data.name: TaskForToday
data.comment: The result after Undo once a task was added for today.

data.name: TaskForDay
data.comment: The result after Undo once a task was added; {0} is a day, « Fri 13 ».

data.name: TaskWithoutDay
data.comment: The result after Undo once a task was added with No day yet. Spec Open 23: « Task, no day » or « Task added ».

data.name: MovedToTrash
data.comment: The result after Undo once a row went to the trash.

data.name: Dismissed
data.comment: What a line of the person's part of Activity says happened to a dismissed information line. Not written in the spec; taken from its summary of the day.

data.name: BackInTriage
data.comment: What an undone line of Activity says in place of its result.

data.name: AddTask
data.comment: The task control of a row when no day is proposed.

data.name: AddTaskForDay
data.comment: The task control of a row with its proposed day; {0} is a day, « Fri 13 ». Spec Open 12, frame 19B.

data.name: SenderNotVerified
data.comment: The framed label of a row whose sender failed the checks.

data.name: UnreadableImagesOnly
data.comment: The framed label of a mail the sorting could not read because it holds only images. Not worded in the spec.

data.name: UnreadableEncrypted
data.comment: The framed label of a mail the sorting could not read because it is encrypted. Not worded in the spec.

data.name: ReasonNewsletter
data.comment: The framed word of a mail set aside as a newsletter.

data.name: ReasonPromotion
data.comment: The framed word of a mail set aside as a promotion.

data.name: ReasonReceipt
data.comment: The framed word of a mail set aside as a receipt.

data.name: ReasonNoActionNeeded
data.comment: The framed word of a mail set aside that needs no action.

data.name: SummaryToday
data.comment: The first part of the summary of the day.

data.name: SummarySeparator
data.comment: Between two parts of the summary of the day, spaces included.

data.name: SummaryTaskOne
data.comment: The tasks part of the summary of the day, for one task.

data.name: SummaryTaskMany
data.comment: The tasks part of the summary of the day, for several tasks.

data.name: SummaryMovedToTrash
data.comment: The trash part of the summary of the day.

data.name: SummaryDismissed
data.comment: The dismissed part of the summary of the day.

data.name: NothingWaiting
data.comment: The sentence of Triage when no subject waits and the sorting runs.
